test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that contains a grammatical error in the underlined portion.

He was always been a grumpy man so I never liked him and avoided his company.

options.text: He was always been a grumpy man, __so I never liked him__ and avoided his company
__He was always been__ a grumpy man, so I never liked him and avoided his company
He was always been __a grumpy man__, so I never liked him and avoided his company.
He was always been a grumpy man, so I never liked him __and avoided his company__.

solution:
The correct answer is : **Options 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "was always been" is grammatically incorrect; the correct construction is **"was always" or "has always been."**
 
• The continuous form "been" does not work with the past simple "was," so it should be eliminated from the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the sentence should read: *"**He was always** a grumpy man, so I never liked him and avoided his company."*
 
• *Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2". ***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The simple past tense** "was"** indicates that the state of being grumpy was continuous in the past.
 
• The present perfect tense** "has been" **suggests a state that began in the past and continues to the present.
